question: What remedial procedure is required when the rosary thread becomes worn out?
premises: The thread of the rosary is worn.
A new thread is tied on.
One hundred recitations are prescribed afterward.
inference: When the thread is worn, one should tie a new thread and recite the mantra one hundred times.
plain_english: If the thread is worn, one should tie on a new thread and recite the mantra one hundred times.
